name: verazuo/jailbreak_llms
description: ACM CCS 2024 research dataset containing 15,140 prompts including 1,405 in-the-wild jailbreak prompts collected from Reddit, Discord, and specialized websites between December 2022 and 2023, with evaluation frameworks for analyzing prompt effectiveness.
score_rationale: Largest published real-world jailbreak prompt dataset with 3.6k stars and ACM CCS 2024 peer review, valuable for LLM safety research and red-team testing.
summary: ACM CCS 2024 research dataset containing 15,140 prompts including 1,405 in-the-wild jailbreak prompt
